description: List templates and variables available for SMS. Ready ones come in Italian, English, German, French and Spanish (locale): use the language of the people who receive them; your own templates have no locale. Field formats: data DD/MM/YYYY (21/11/2026), ora HH:MM 24-hour (15:30), importo 12,50 € or €12.50, nome letters only, ordine/codice letters, digits and dashes, attivita your business name, link/url only on the verified site.
name: message_templates
